description: A high-performance sports coupe with twin-turbo engine.

Audi RS7 Performance is a luxury high-performance sport back powered by a 4.0L twin-turbo V8 engine producing 621 horsepower. It combines supercar-level acceleration with everyday practicality, featuring Quattro all-wheel drive, premium interior materials, and advanced driver assistance technologies.

Mercedes-AMG C63 S E Performance is a high-performance luxury sedan powered by a 2.0L turbocharged engine combined with an electric motor, producing a total of 671 horsepower. It features AMG Performance 4MATIC+, adaptive suspension, premium interior, and cutting-edge technology for both comfort and speed.
